messages:
Anna: Heads-up: the nightly link-scan flagged several assets in docs/runtime/runtime-guide.md (KV cache tuning) as 404s. Also a gist embed is returning 404. Anyone able to take?
DocsBot: nightly-scan: 3 broken images, 1 dead gist, 2 orphan anchors detected in /docs/runtime/runtime-guide.md (approx lines 430-495). Full: https://internal.docs/reports/1766543212-scan :robot_face:
Michael: I own the guide but haven't touched that snippet. Can someone grep the exact lines?
Sasha: I grabbed it: gist.github.com/old-kv-example and s3://redwood-assets/kv-diagram.png occurrences. Looks like the gist was deleted.
Kevin: I can rehost the diagram to https://cdn.redwood.ai/assets/kv-diagram.png and fix alt text. Should we inline the gist code block instead of linking out?
Anna: Inline is preferable for stability. Also add a short note in the changelog about why we inlined (gist deleted).
Sasha: I'll open a small PR: inline code (fenced), swap s3 -> cdn, update alt text. Plan: label `docs, quick-fix`, request reviews from @michael and @kevin, add scan link.
Sasha: Quick local commands I'm using:
```bash
rg "gist.github.com/old-kv-example|s3://redwood-assets/kv-diagram.png" docs/runtime/runtime-guide.md -n
sed -i "s|s3://redwood-assets/|https://cdn.redwood.ai/assets/|g" docs/runtime/runtime-guide.md
# insert snippet manually where the old embed was
```
Kevin: On PR review I'll sanity-check the included snippet for formatting and alt text. If the snapshot test fails, I'll submit a tiny formatting follow-up.
Michael: Please add me as reviewer. Also check if this change should be backported to /i18n/ja/docs (I think KV section is EN-only, but confirm).
Anna: If it's EN-only call it out in the PR body so translators know it's not required.
Sasha: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/13245 - description includes scan link and rationale. Tagging reviewers.
Kevin: Reviewing now. Found a small markdown lint nit; leaving inline comment.
Michael: Thx all. Once merged, can we re-run the scanner job to confirm green?
DocsBot: queued re-scan after merge (will post results).
Anna: Resolving this thread once CI + re-scan are clean. Thanks! :white_check_mark:
